# experiment/results/ — index

Each directory holds the kept artefacts — `canaries.jsonl` /
`forget_passages.jsonl` (ground truth), `extraction.jsonl` (the
experiment's output), `metrics.json`, `*_steps.jsonl` /
`*_log.jsonl` (train/unlearn telemetry), `gpu_snapshot.jsonl`, and —
for the major ones — a `RESULTS.md` with the verdict. The consolidated
narrative lives in `experiment/wave_1/WAVE_1.md`; this is a directory
map.

`SCHEMA.md` documents the JSONL schemas (`qquilt.canaries.v1`,
`qquilt.train.banner.v1`, `qquilt.extract.v2`, etc.).

**Not committed (`.gitignore`d — regenerated by the pipeline scripts):**
`corpus.jsonl` / `retain.jsonl` / `calib_*.jsonl` (rebuilt by
`qquilt.data` from the canaries + the HF Enron sample, deterministically
from the seed), `extraction_part*.jsonl` / `*_orphan.jsonl` /
`extraction_awq.jsonl` (intermediate concat pieces superseded by the
final `extraction.jsonl`), `*.partial.json` (incremental dumps),
`_*.jsonl` / `_*.txt` (temp files). Also `refs/literature/*.pdf`
(convenience copies of cited arXiv papers — not part of the artefact).
Run `scripts/reproduce_full.sh` (or the individual `scripts/*.sh`) to
regenerate everything from the committed seeds + manifest.

## Wave 0 / Wave 1 mini core

| Dir | What | Headline |
|---|---|---|
| `wave_0/` | W0 sanity smoke | gate PASSED; L2 fragility (Q4_K_M breaks c1 at char 7) |
| `wave_1_mini/` | W1 mini Phase A + Phase B + Step 1 + RESULTS.md | Phase A: BF16/Q8 30, Q5 25, Q4 6 — nested subsets, A1=1, L3=0. Phase B: AWQ-canary-free **0/100**. Step 1: AWQ-canary-cal 1/100. |
| `wave_1_qwen_mini/` | Step 2 — Qwen-0.5B cross-family | BF16 29, Q8 28, Q5 8, Q4 3 — same shape as Llama-1B; L3=0 |
| `wave_1_qwen15b_mini/` | Step 2b — Qwen-1.5B cross-family | **first L3 hit**: c0018 (bucket=3), Q8 reproduces 116 chars verbatim, BF16 only 5. L3=1/100; broader "Q8 > BF16" = 3/100 |
| `wave_1_freq1_mini/` | Step 3 — Qwen-0.5B + freq {1,3,10} | nothing extracts at freq=1 in any version; refutes sub-memorisation-amplification |
| `step_4_ga_gdr/` | Step 4 v2 — GA_GDR unlearn (threshold=5) + 6 quants | 0/100 across all 6 versions; PII-canary unlearning is quant-robust |
| `step_4_ga_gdr_collapsed_v1/` | Step 4 v1 (no threshold) — **archived failure**: GA collapsed the model to `= = = =` garbage. Kept for the record. |
| `step_5_awq_canary100/` | Step 5 — AWQ + 100% canary calibration | 0/100 — saliency mechanism refuted, calibration is a flat knob |
| `step_6_awq_wikitext/` | Step 6 — AWQ + WikiText OOD calibration | 0/100 — 4th calibration-ablation point; curve flat 0-1/100 across 0→100% canary |
| `step_7_awq_granularity/` | Step 7 — AWQ group_size sweep; `extraction_g{32,64,128}.jsonl` + `metrics.json` | greedy ≥10 chars (G1): g32 (~5.0 bpw) 4/100, g64 (~4.5 bpw) 0/100, g128 (~4.25 bpw) 0/100 → AWQ's bpw cliff sits ~0.3-0.5 bpw above the GGUF k-quants' (AWQ-g64 0/100 vs Q4_K_M 6/100 at matched bpw). g256 not evaluable (autoawq triton kernel doesn't support gs=256; no CUDA AWQ kernel on sm_120/3060) |
| `step_8_gguf_lowbit/` | Step 8 — Q3_K_M + Q2_K extension | BF16 30 → Q8 30 → Q5 25 → Q4 6 → Q3 0 → Q2 0; boundary ≈ 4.5 bpw |
| `step_9_zhang_nl_replication/` | Step 9 — Zhang replication, NL (Wikipedia) forget set on 1B (`extraction.jsonl` = 5 unlearned versions; `extraction_target.jsonl` = pre-unlearn TARGET; `metrics.json` = ROUGE-L per version) | TARGET BF16 ROUGE-L 0.68 (34/100 ≥0.8) → GA_GDR unlearn → 0.06; post-unlearn quant Δ ≈ −0.001…−0.004 (Q8/Q5/Q4_K_M), +0.025 (AWQ); `n ROUGE ≥ 0.8` = 0 everywhere → Zhang's 21%→83% recovery does NOT replicate at 1B/Wikipedia |
| `wave_1_utility/` | Utility eval + RESULTS.md | AWQ-canary-free ~9-13% PPL increase; not a lobotomy; calibration irrelevant for utility too; clean defence-utility frontier |

## Consensus-attack smokes

| Dir | What | Headline |
|---|---|---|
| `smoke_1_consensus/` | Soft-metrics consensus + RESULTS.md | A_consensus = 1.000 on PII content; whole-suffix 100/100 was template/boilerplate |
| `smoke_2_hayes_np/` | Hayes (n,p)-discoverable + RESULTS.md | AWQ 0/100 at (n=1000, p=0.999); BF16 figure flagged inflated by tokenization-boundary issue |
| `smoke_3_icl_picompass/` | ICL k-shot priming | demonstrations *hurt* greedy extraction (30→1→0→0); ICL not a knob |
| (`exp_semantic_similarity/`) | All-MPNet cosine post-process | AWQ cos_mean 0.43 < 0.5 (1/100 ≥0.8) vs Q4_K_M 0.74 (33/100) — defence holds at the semantic level |
